subaccounts.description: Indicates if the certificate is enabled for use in sub-accounts

type.description:
Certificate type:
If the certificate type is `CRT` it is required to send `crt_file` and `crt_private_key_file`, if the type is `PFX` it is required `pfx_file` and `pfx_password`.

* `crt` CRT
* `pfx` PFX

files.description:
Certificate file and password.
If the certificate type is `CRT` it is required to send `crt_file` and `crt_private_key_file`, if the type is `PFX` it is required `pfx_file` and `pfx_password`.

body.description: Information of the certificate to be added.
